Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Ewok And Roll]]: a poster for Richard Nader's "1950's Rock & Roll Revival" at the Spectrum, Philadelphia (1973), with Chuck Berry, Bill Haley and the Comets, Bo Diddley, the Coasters and others.

Unchanged.
